90 LESSONS, 400+ QUESTIONS, 10+ TESTS
Access all the practice you'll need to pass the test. Study chapter by chapter, and try over 400 questions at the end of the lessons. Time-limited tests help you test your knowledge with the 60-minute time limit of the actual test. Get feedback on your correct and incorrect answers.

SMART FLASHCARDS
Don't know the meaning of traffic signs and symbols? No worries! Access to a full content-focused flashcards system designed to teach you all the traffic sign symbols you need to know. You can do a regular round of flashcards when starting off, and then a smart round where we focus on signs you need to practice more, based on your flashcards performance.

LISTEN TO THE LESSONS
Use the audio-enabled lessons and easily follow each paragraph, word by word with better concentration.

TRACK TEST & STUDY PROGRESS
Keep track of your progress through the chapters and lessons. Keep track of your test scores and average time. Easily pick up where you left off with the Continue Studying shortcut.

FULL OFFLINE MODE
Study on the go! Use the app wherever you go without an internet connection, and still access all the lessons, quizzes and tests.
